questions.title: How many votes of no confidence will Thai PM Anutin Charnvirakul receive?
questions.background:

questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the number of House of Representatives members voting for a motion of no confidence against Thailand's prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul, in the first such vote being held before December 23, 2026.
questions.fine_print: If no such vote takes place before December 23, 2026, the question resolves as **140 or fewer**
